# Virtual network

A virtual network without subnets. Each subnet is its own resource, so redeploying the network never touches them.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-readme.sh from the compiled template. Edit the @description and @metadata decorators instead. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Use it | `module m… 'br/platform:modules/network/vnet:v1.0.0' = { … }` |
| Deploys at | resource group scope |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [pContext](#pcontext) | yes | [contextType](#contexttype) |
| [pName](#pname) | yes | string |
| [pAddressPrefixes](#paddressprefixes) | yes | string[] |
| [pDnsServers](#pdnsservers) | no | string[] |

### pContext

Where the virtual network is deployed.

- Type: [contextType](#contexttype)

### pName

Purpose of the virtual network, used in its name.

- Type: string
- Example: `hub`

### pAddressPrefixes

Address space of the virtual network.

- Type: string[]
- Example: `["10.10.0.0/22"]`

### pDnsServers

DNS servers for the virtual network. Empty uses the Azure-provided DNS.

- Type: string[]
- Default: `[]`
- Example: `["10.10.4.4","10.10.4.5"]`

## Types

### contextType

Where a resource is deployed. Every module takes it as pContext.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| environment | yes | [environmentType](#environmenttype) | Environment short name, used in every resource name. |
| location | yes | [regionType](#regiontype) | Azure region of the resources. |
| tags | no | object | Tags added to every resource. Example: `{"workload":"sample-app","owner":"platform-team"}` |

### environmentType

Environment short name. Each environment has its own management group hierarchy and subscriptions.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `dev`, `prod`

### regionType

Azure regions this platform deploys to. Each one has a short code in regionCode().

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `switzerlandnorth`, `switzerlandwest`, `westeurope`

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| oName | string | Name of the virtual network. |
| oId | string | Resource ID of the virtual network. |
